## 解决的问题 / Problem

关联 Issue、触发条件和预期结果 / Related issue, trigger, and expected result.

## 修改内容 / Changes

说明最终行为及兼容性影响 / Describe the resulting behavior and compatibility impact.

## 验证 / Verification

- [ ] 构建和针对性验证通过，列出命令及环境 / Build and relevant checks passed; list commands and environment.
- [ ] `git diff --check` 通过 / passed.
- [ ] 公共行为变化已同步示例和中英文文档 / Examples and bilingual docs updated for public changes.
- [ ] UI 修改附截图和交互结果（如适用）/ Screenshots and interaction results included for UI changes.

未验证内容与原因 / Unverified behavior and reasons:
